programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stick 'Em Up
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Head Games
programme.desc: A young couple decided to celebrate their first wedding anniversary with a camping trip to Mount Hood. During the trip, the husband was shot and killed. Later, his wife told two different versions of the events which led to his death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Making the Collar
programme.desc: The body of 16-year-old Leanne Tiernan was discovered nine months after she disappeared. Forensic scientists found clues that painted a virtual portrait of her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Financial Downfall
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman falls to her death from a cliff overlooking the ocean. Initially, investigators think it was a tragic accident. But after a forensic examination, police uncover a very different picture of what happened.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Remorse
programme.desc: A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Human Animal
programme.desc: The naked body of a vibrant young mother is found frozen solid in a deserted cemetery. Kenda reopens the investigation and recognizes the sinister hallmark of a serial killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Trigger
programme.desc: A sharp-dressed pedestrian is shot in the back for unknown reasons. Chasing a promising lead, Kenda realizes he’s barking up the wrong tree.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Loose Cannon
programme.desc: In the dead of night, a shooter on a rampage rips through a home, leaving a grandmother disfigured, her 24 year old daughter dead, and a two year-old child clinging to life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Grip
programme.desc: When a speeding truck crashes into a residential building, officers find the lifeless body of Michael Faast behind the wheel. But he didn’t die in the wreck – he was shot point-blank in the temple.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: After School Special
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes when a beloved teacher is poisoned in her classroom. As doctors fight to save Barbara Lewis’ life, Lt. Joe Kenda and his team delve into her personal affairs.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive
programme.desc: When a beloved grandmother is found stabbed to death in her own home, Kenda must turn to a tight-knit community still grieving from the tragic loss.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity
programme.desc: This film features unexpected historical insights, cutting-edge science and exciting new experiments. From Einstein's Relativity to quantum mechanics, host Jim Al-Khalili explores one of the most extraordinary phenomena in our universe.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found
programme.desc: Beyond Earth Orbit - The Apollo program takes bold new steps. IXV Re-entry Vehicle - Europe is working to perfect a re-entry vehicle. Galileo Satellites Lost and Found - Navigation satellites go into incorrect orbit.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA
programme.desc: To the Moon - The Apollo program achieves its major objective. Dragon, Falcon and Spacex - New directions in re-usable spacecraft. Gaia- Mapping our galaxy in unprecedented detail.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Written in Blood: Clare Mackintosh
programme.desc: Clare Mackintosh takes Simon to Northern Ireland to explore a case that has remarkable parallels to one of her books. A plot that seems too far-fetched to write, unfolds in quiet rural County Derry.

programme.title: Written in Blood: Tess Gerritsen
programme.desc: Tess Gerritsen invites Simon to the US, where an incredible real life case inspired her book Body Double, explores whether being a killer is the product of nature or nurture.

programme.title: Written in Blood: Mason Cross
programme.desc: Mason Cross invites Simon back to his hometown of Glasgow, and a case which literally unfolded on his doorstep - a double murder that had police stumped, and saw police knocking on Mason’s door.

programme.title: Written in Blood: Peter Robinson
programme.desc: Peter Robinson invites Simon to Yorkshire - the setting for his successful DCI Banks series, he wants Simon to learn about a real case that unfolded in front of his favourite landscape.

programme.title: Written in Blood: Karin Slaughter
programme.desc: Karin Slaughter asks Simon to join her in Atlanta, Georgia, where she informs Simon about a spree killer who terrorised the whole of the US, and came within a few miles of her family home.

programme.title: Written in Blood: Sophie Hannah
programme.desc: Sophie Hannah takes Simon to Nottingham, where she leads him through a case which left the authorities scratching their heads for 30 years. Sophie is the current writer of the Poirot books.

programme.desc: Medics aren't always available on the battlefield, so military leaders have developed specialized medical training for all soldiers, known as Combat Casualty Care, because IEDs and other types of bombs are wounding far too many personnel.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Conqueror
programme.desc: Humankind conquered the world, in order to survive, and conquers his fellow humans with new ideas. We will see how we as a species have conquered the earth, how we still compete with viruses, and how quantum theory conquers China.

programme.title: On the Case: Last Call

programme.title: On the Case: Deep Wounds

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry & Hakkespettene
programme.desc: Når basketball-treneren til Piper slutter, blir Henry den nye treneren. Mens han prøver å piske laget i form blir han utfordret av 'The league board' og deres uortodokse regler.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Captain Man: På Ferie
programme.desc: Ray stoler på at Henry og Charlotte beskytter Swellview mens han er i brullup hos sin kusine. Problemer oppstår når de må ordne ting på egen hånd.

programme.title: Henry Danger: The Time Jerker
programme.desc: Når Kid Danger og Captain Man sloss mot Time Bandit faller Kid Danger tilfeldigvis inn i tidsmaskinen til Time Bandit og opplever den samme dagen om og om igjen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Luksus Biff
programme.desc: Med en invitasjon til den beste restauranten i Swellview bestemmer Henry seg for å ta med seg sjefen sin, Ray. Det blir mer komplisert enn han forventet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Sjalue Henry
programme.desc: Etter at Jasper blir hyllet som en lokal helt blir Henry sjalu for at Kid Danger blir takket og ikke ham selv.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jul med Danger
programme.desc: Når Captain Man blir arrestert for tyveri blir han nødt til å tilbringe julen i fengsel. Henry og Charlotte må prøve å hjelpe Captain Man så han får en fin jul i fengselet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Uskadelige Henry: Del 1
programme.desc: Når Kid Danger blir skadet på et oppdrag, bestemmer Henry seg for å bli like uovervinnelig som Captain Man. Men ting blir ikke helt som Henry hadde håpet at det skulle bli.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Uskadelig Henry Del 2
programme.desc: Når Henry får en uventet skavank, må han skjule den for familien mens gjengen jobber med å få ham tilbake til normalen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tekst, Løgner og Video
programme.desc: Når en video av Henry og Ray, der de blir til Kid Danger og Captain Man, kommer ut må Henry kjempe for å få den tilbake slik at ikke hemmeligheten hans blir avslørt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Motsatt Univers
programme.desc: Henry og Charlotte blir transportert inn i et omvendt univers hvor Ray og Schwoz er onde og prøver å ødelegge Piper. De må stoppe onde Ray og onde Schwoz og finne ut hvordan de skal klare og komme seg tilbake.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Danger & Thunder Del 1
programme.desc: Captain Man, Kid Danger og Phoebe Thunderman infiltrerer et hemmelig skurkemøte i Smellview hvor skurkene planlegger og skade Captain Man og Kid Danger. På møtet oppdager Phoebe uventet gjest - broren Max.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så han først
programme.desc: Når Carly og Sam viser interesse for den samme fyren, lover de at han ikke skal komme imellom dem. Men det er vanskelig, og når de slåss om hans oppmerksomhet, blir vennskapet deres satt på prøve.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack rat
programme.desc: Carly må trå til når Spencer blir avhengig av et videospil. Sam lurer Freddie til å tro at han blir forfulgt av uhell når han nekter å sende et kjedebrev videre.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg skylder deg en
programme.desc: Sam blir fornærmet når Freddie beskylder henne for ikke å betale ham og Carly noen av de pengene tilbake som hun konstant låner. Sam prøver iherdig å betale dem tilbake - hun finner seg en ordentlig jobb.

programme.title: iCarly: Hubert Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Lur Lewbert"-sketsj går helt galt og skader Carlys irriterende portvakt. Gjengen pleier ham inntil Freddies mor tar over. Men når kærligheten begynner å blomstre, må de sette en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Pie
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Spencer tar med Freddie til deres yndlingskonditori, finner de ut at eieren er død. Men enda verre er det at oppskriftene hans kanskje er gått tapt for alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: Jul
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å pifte opp julen med et utradisjonelt tre, kommer Spencer til å sette fyr på alle Carlys gaver. Fortvilet ønsker hun seg at hun hadde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kysset
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortelle Carly at han aldri har kysset en jente, og avslører hemmeligheten hans på netshowet. Gibby og Carly trener Spencer til utttaket for det lokale, profesjonelle fotballaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Bilbråk
programme.desc: Gjengen holder en konkurranse på iCarly, og premien er en ny bil fra en lokal forhandler. Etter at Nevel vinner, oppdager barna at forhandleren ikke visste noe om konkurransen eller bilen de skulle ha donert bort som premie.

programme.title: iCarly: Fred
programme.desc: Freddie sier offentlig at han ikke er fan av internettsensasjonen Fred, noe som får Fred til å meddele at han skal slutte å legge ut filmer for alltid. Fansen blir rasende fordi Freddie har forårsaket slutten på de populære filmene.

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Etterdønningene etter Jennas krangel med vennene gjør at hun går ut en kveld. Men det som skulle bli en kveld for å lette på trykket blir en kveld hun må reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide at Jenna kommer inn på rett spor igjen, men hun har forårsaket mer skade for sine nærmeste enn det som kan rettes opp med litt PR. Vil de tilgi henne, eller må hun ta i bruk drastiske midler?

programme.title: Awkward
programme.desc: Jenna og jentene er venner igjen og Jenna tror at hun er klar for å gjenoppta kjærlighetsaffæren med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håper at hvis hun retter opp sine feil ved å hjelpe Val med å få tilbake jobben sin, vil universet belønne henne med å sørge for at hun og Matty blir sammen igjen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna utfordres til å sette spørsmålstegn ved hvem hun vil være i denne episke sesongfinalen.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: En pinlig stund venter når vi tar en titt på de beste klippene fra 'Awkward' der skuespillerne selv kommenterer de morsomste replikkene, de saftigste forholdene og mye mer fra deres favorittepisoder av Awkward.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: Sisteårsrampestreker lager kaos mens Jennas forsett om å slutte å tenke på Matty blir satt på prøve når hun overhører en forstyrrende hemmelighet.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna forårsaker en ulykke på skolen som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvensene av konfrontasjonen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyter litt popularitet, sliter Matty med å bli holdt utenfor. Samtidig prøver Jake seg på den nye jenta, og Ally holder en sexleke-fest.

programme.title: Mando Diao MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Med gjesteartister som Ane Brun, Kristofer Greczula og Veera Pyykkö inntar Mando Diao MTV Unplugged-scenen. Pluto TV byr på en nedstrippet og intim konsert med Mando Diao fra deres nye album «Efter Solnedgången».

programme.title: Lenny Kravitz MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Lenny Kravitz unplugged.

programme.title: Alicia Keys MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Alicia Keys performs Unplugged at the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Paul McCartney MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: MTV Unplugged,' world premiered this one hour performance with the legendary Paul McCartney. This performance was simulcast via the Global Satellite Network. Taped on January 25, 1991 at the Limehouse Studios in London.

programme.title: John Mellencamp MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This one-hour episode with beloved American rocker John Mellencamp was taped in Los Angeles in April of 1992, and features a medley of Mellencamp hits, past and present.

programme.title: Workaholics: The Promotion
programme.desc: Alice antyder at noen skal bli forfremmet på jobben. Anders, Adam og Blake føler at de fortjener en forfremmelse og konkurrerer om den.

programme.title: Workaholics: We Be Ballin'
programme.desc: Adam møter sin 'tredje kjærlighet' på en fest. Guttene lyver og sier at de har billetter til en utsolgt basketballkamp for å imponere henne. Blake ser noe han ikke burde ha sett.

programme.title: Workaholics: Office Campout
programme.desc: Anders, Adam og Blake overnatter på kontoret. De tar på seg t-sjorter på som er laget spesielt for turen. Når de tar sopp møter de på innbruddstyver mens de tripper.

programme.desc: Owen Benjamin utforsker hvor ekle pissoarer er, og undersøker forholdsproblemer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Gang Stand-Off
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer gangstere som er gale etter 'Twilight,' besøk i en verden der navn er promper, og rasistiske superhelter.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Y'all Ready For This?
programme.desc: Et fotballag girer seg opp før en kamp, president Obama og Luther møter Hillary Clinton, to karer forbereder seg på potensielle trusler på et fly, pirater synger en sang og en betjent er litt for skyteglad.

programme.title: Key & Peele: I'm Retired
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en ungkars-fest som blir underlig og en svart fyr med en hvit penis.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bitch
programme.desc: I denne seriepremierer av komiprogrammet prøver Jordan Peele og Keegan Michael Key å si et forbudt ord om deres kvinner, Lil Wayne venner seg til livet bak lås og slå, og president Obama uttrykker hva han egentlig føler.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Joke Stealing
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en fotballspiller som blir straffet for å juble for mye, Jordan og Keegan som går på premieren på "Othello" og en high school-elev som blir berømt for å stjele en vits.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Flicker
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan har en flickerkamp og en MMA-fighter går for langt når han erter motstanderen. Andre sketsjer inkluderer en bryllupsgjest somvil være dj og spille "klassiske" låter.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Hollywood Sequel Doctor
programme.desc: Kileleking mellem to venner blir plutselig merkelig, forfattere brainstormer til 'Gremlins 2', to bøller mistenker vennen sin for å stjele og Keegan og Jordan diskuterer Afrika på en fest.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Black Ice News
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer Samuel og Lashawn som gleder seg over fordelene ved sine nå lovlige ekteskap, en politibetjent som møter sin nye makker og Lando fra 'Star Wars' blir forfulgt av et superfan.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Meegan & Andre Break Up
programme.desc: To venner kommer i klammeri på en klubb, Meegan og André har en seriøs samtale, en rapper går fra et intervju, Conrad flyr business class og Keegan har en ny bart.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Soul Food
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan diskuterer hvem som er mest svart, og å være den eneste svarte på en fest. Sketsjer inkluderer Tea Party som oppdager et nytt håp, hærens ververe som tenker annerledes, og Bobby McFerrin som duellerer mot Michael Winslow.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Airplane Showdown
programme.desc: En flyvert må håndtere en passasjer som ikke vil ha på sikkerhetsbeltet, britiske oppdagelsesreisende diskuterer sine reiser, to par forsøker å unngå spoilere på en dobbeltdate og en bibelgruppe opplever en guddommelig intervensjon.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Short Tail Spy

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Legacy

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 103

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 105

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 201
programme.desc: Programleder Camilla Ottesen, eiendomsmegler Tobias Edlev Nielsen og arkitekt Mads Kappel Mikkelsen besøker Ida og Aske på Østerbro. De har vært på jakt etter bolig i et år, men har ikke funnet drømmehjemmet.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 202
programme.desc: Eiendomsmegleren Tobias og arkitekten Mads får en vanskelig oppgave, når de skal finne et hus til Lea og Sebastian fra Brønshøj.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: West Sweden

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Luleå

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Halmstad

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: West Sweden

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Florø

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Financial Downfall
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman falls to her death from a cliff overlooking the ocean. Initially, investigators think it was a tragic accident. But after a forensic examination, police uncover a very different picture of what happened.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Haunted by the disappearance of her mother, a young woman undertakes an investigation of her own. In her mother's diary, she discovers a dark family secret that might explain the disappearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over a Barrel
programme.desc: California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pinned by the Evidence
programme.desc: After a street fight takes the life of a national wrestling champion, police must determine if he was killed in cold blood or in self-defense.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cries Unheard
programme.desc: A 19-year-old woman was found dead in her car; the scene had been staged to make murder appear to be suicide. During their investigation, police discovered the victim was involved in a love quadrangle, giving several people a motive to kill her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Buried Treasure
programme.desc: A man disappears one year to the day after beginning an affair with his friend's wife. 15 years later, with the help of a metal detector, police find evidence that would prove what had happened and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Badge of Betrayal
programme.desc: When the body of a young woman is found under an isolated highway ramp, a unique fiber on the victim's clothing leads San Diego police straight to the most unlikely of killers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Matrimony
programme.desc: A go-go dancer told her family she needed to get away for a while and then she simply disappeared. Investigators were suspicious, because she took neither her car nor her clothes. 20 years later, her family received a call that changed everything.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muddy Waters
programme.desc: A Colorado hunter is the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspect two weapons and two killers. But forensic evidence points them in a different direction — one much closer to home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Point of Origin
programme.desc: In 1984, California firefighters battled ten arson fires in three weeks. When cigarettes and a scrap of paper connected the case to similar fires further north, the hunt was on for a dangerous pyromaniac.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Crime Spree
programme.desc: They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive
programme.desc: When a beloved grandmother is found stabbed to death in her own home, Kenda must turn to a tight-knit community still grieving from the tragic loss.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Poker Face
programme.desc: A group of friends discover the corpse of entrepreneur Jamie Foster hidden under a blanket. Kenda e discovers that Foster’s business put him in close quarters with a host of unsavory characters.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Uninvited Guest
programme.desc: A soldier is stabbed to death at a drive-thru. Kenda’s only clue is that this is somehow tied to a breakdancing competition.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Who Took Heather?
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl is missing, sending Kenda’s city into a panic. A cryptic letter to the District Attorney’s office suggests the girl isn’t the only victim.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Blood
programme.desc: A army vet is found bleeding to death on the asphalt of a parking lot -- his chest littered with too many knife wounds to count. Kenda’s case is stuck in first gear until a gruesome clue appears.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Written in Blood: Sophie Hannah
programme.desc: Sophie Hannah takes Simon to Nottingham, where she leads him through a case which left the authorities scratching their heads for 30 years. Sophie is the current writer of the Poirot books.

programme.title: Death By Gossip: A Killer Education
programme.desc: When the body of English Teacher, Susan Reinert is found stuffed into the back of her car, police turn to her ex-husband for answers.

programme.title: Death By Gossip: Mother's Day Murder
programme.desc: Neighbors are shocked when their neighbor, Patricia Mery is found stabbed to death in her own home. Which rumors will crack the case wide open and which will bog down the investigation?

programme.title: Death By Gossip
programme.desc: Colleen Slemmer is thrilled to start computer classes at the job corps campus in Knoxville, Tennessee. Months later, Colleen is found stabbed and police must determine - was Colleen killed by gossip?

programme.title: Death By Gossip
programme.desc: When professional rodeo rider Randy Flynn is gunned down near his Kansas home, investigators hit a wall of whispers. Rumors fly of a philandering pastor and sex shop scandals.

programme.desc: Police conduct a sting operation. A woman is covered in white powder during a traffic stop. Officers spot a young boy on a bike who wandered away from home.

programme.title: Cops: Not a Momma's Boy
programme.desc: Officers are called to fight between a mother and her son. Officers respond to a man on a trolley hurling racial slurs at a passenger. A traffic stop uncovers narcotics in a young man's trunk.

programme.title: Cops: All Aboard!
programme.desc: Officers pursue a truck driving backwards on a freeway. A suspect jumps a train to evade police. A woman claims to be disabled when a pill falls from her pocket.

programme.title: Cops: To the Lighthouse
programme.desc: Officers are called to a restaurant after the owner was held at gunpoint. Police respond to a woman being sexually harassed in a park. A drunk man tells police he is going to buy a lighthouse.

programme.title: Cops: Get a Room
programme.desc: A man claims to be protecting the car he broke into. Officers are called to when a couple gets too friendly while out in public. Police are dispatched when a drunk woman pounds on her neighbor's door.

programme.title: Cops: Connect Four
programme.desc: Deputies assist border patrol in pursuit of a vehicle that has blown both a checkpoint and its tires. A drunk woman is pulled over not knowing she is missing a tire.

programme.title: Cops: When Ya Gotta Go

programme.title: Cops: I Always pay my Debts

programme.title: Cops: Skipping Rocks

programme.title: Cops: Tow Time

programme.title: iCarly: Fred
programme.desc: Freddie sier offentlig at han ikke er fan av internettsensasjonen Fred, noe som får Fred til å meddele at han skal slutte å legge ut filmer for alltid. Fansen blir rasende fordi Freddie har forårsaket slutten på de populære filmene.

programme.title: iCarly: Dobbelt opp
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie sniker seg ut for å dra til en MMA-kamp, får de sine dobbeltgjengere til å lure Spencer til å tro at de fortsatt er hjemme. Imens bygger Spencer en kjempeversjon av Newton Balls.

programme.title: iCarly: Om hva for noe?
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie oppfordrer iCarly-fans til å stemme på David Archuleta i "Amerika Sings", syns de synd på nummer to og hjelper ham med å lage en musikkvideo.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg skal gjøre Sam jentete
programme.desc: Da Sam innrømmer at hun liker en gutt på skolen, lærer Carly henne hvordan hun kan lokke ham til seg ved å oppføre seg mere feminint. Spencer er overbevist om at en jente liker ham pga. smokingen hans, så han går med den hele tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 1
programme.desc: Når Carly dater er en tøffing, prøver hun å holde forholdet skjult for Spencer. Og Sam betaler Freddie for å lage en hjemmeside der hun kan legge ut alle sine ekle videofavoritter.

programme.title: iCarly: Gjenforening med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle venninne Missy flytter tilbake til Seattle, tror Sam at Missy prøver å skifte henne ut som Carlys bestevenninne.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg må ha skap 239
programme.desc: Når Sam og Freddie begge to vinner konkurransen for skolens beste skap, slir de nødt til å dele skap. Carly ber Spencer gi henne timer i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly utdelingen
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie holder en iCarly-galla for de beste bruker-bidragene i iCarly, og hyller pristagerne live på web-showet. Spencer verver europeiske badedraktmodeller for å hjelpe ham å lage premiestatuettene.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillinger
programme.desc: Freddie prøver å bevise at Melanie, Sams tvillingesøster, er Sam i forkledning. Når Carly underviser Spencers nemesis, Chuck, prøver Spencer å overbevise henne om at Chuck er ond.

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 2
programme.desc: Når Carly oppdager at hennes tøffe kjæreste Griffin samler på små Pee Wee Babies, må hun ta stilling til om hun holder ut å date en kar som har en kosedyrsamling. I mens forsøker Spencer å hjelpe Sam med å bli kvitt et mareritt.

programme.title: iCarly: iKamp mot Dingo
programme.desc: Dingo-kanalen har stjålet idéer fra iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer drar til Dingos Studio for å fortelle manusforfatterne hva de mener om det.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Ett par får en stor makt som skaper usikkerhet i gjengen. Hvem ender opp med det sorte hjertet og må sjekke ut før parseremonien?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Vampyra hersker over det mørke riket og sprer frykt i paradis. Guttene må underkaste seg hennes vilje i jakten på en partner.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 903

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Girl I Married

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Prime Mover

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Long Distance Call

programme.desc: A young woman, Christine, returns home to find her mother cold and distant, and living isolated from everyone else. The woman soon discovers that her mother has summoned up...Chrissie.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Old Soft Shoe
programme.desc: Lingerie salesman Chester Caruso checks into a budget motel and makes a pass at a woman who is also checking in. She rejects him, but soon he wakes up in his room to find a different woman, dressed in lingerie, calling him Harry.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Last Car

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Unhappy Medium

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Casavin Curse

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 407
programme.desc: Tess og Nick prøver å få det vaklende forholdet sitt på rett kjøl igjen, men det skjer en eksplosjon som ingen av dem har sett komme.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 408
programme.desc: Når Harry tilbyr Alex og Nick en partnerskapsavtale i Killarney etter sin død, med forbehold om at de gir opp Wilgul og flytter hjem nå, blir guttene enda mer bestemt på å redde gården.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 409
programme.desc: Stevie og Terry stopper ved en forfallen bensinstasjon som drives av en gammel dranker ved navn Ken Logan. Stevie gjenkjenner Ken som en legende i rodeo-kretsen.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 410
programme.desc: Nick inviterer Tess til middag, den romantiske sammenkomsten de har prøvd og mislykket med flere ganger tidligere. Denne gangen tror de at ingenting vil komme i veien for dem.

programme.title: McLeods døtre: Episode 411
programme.desc: Jodi og Stevie har det ikke bra, og Jodi er lei av det hun ser på som Stevies unødvendige risikable oppførsel.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1107
programme.desc: En gjeng gourmetkokker møter en gjeng fryktløse fartsfantomer. Christer Rødseth, Christoffer Davidsen og Trond Moi møter rallyfører Mads Østberg, artist Raylee og snøscooterkjører Marie Sandberg.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1108
programme.desc: Det er lagspillere mot individualister som skal i duell. På det røde fotballaget møter vi Jan Gunnar Solli, Solveig Guldbrandsen og Tobias Becks. På det blå laget finner vi Rasmus Wold, Genette Våge og Victoria Tolaas.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1101
programme.desc: Det er klart for en intens og spektakulær kamp med Kristin Gjelsvik, Dennis Poppe og Oskar Westerlin på det røde laget, mot Herman Dahl, Emilie "Emzia" Helgesen og Christopher Robin Omdahl på det blå laget.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1102
programme.desc: Det er styrke, utholdenhet og akrobatikk som står i fokus når Anders Aukland, Martine Ek Hagen og Marthe Kristoffersen skal kjempe mot Lars Berger, Jonathan Nordbotten og Espen Jansen om den store gullskatten.

programme.title: Fangene på Fortet: Episode 1103
programme.desc: Dagens kamp står mellom Abu Hussain, Mayoo Indiran og Stian Sandø på det blå laget, og Alexandra Joner, Lene Orvik og Sebastian Solberg på det røde laget.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef prøver å kreve royalties da et plateselskap slipper en låt han hevder han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med den nye kjæresten sin til en Jonas Brothers-konsert der de får kyskhetsringer.

programme.title: South Park: Dilla på apefonetikk
programme.desc: Guttene konkurrerer mot hjemmeunderviste barn i South Parks årlige stavekonkurranse.

programme.title: South Park: Bestevenner for alltid
programme.desc: Cartmans blir sjalu når Kenny får det siste nye bærbare spillet før lekebutikkene går tomme. Vil Cartman og Kenny kunne forbli bestevenner for alltid?

programme.title: South Park: Midtbyen
programme.desc: South Parks bykjerne holder på å oppgraderes og Kenny bestemmer bestemmer seg for at det er på tide å skaffe en jobb.

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Etterpåklokskap
programme.desc: Superhelten 'The Coon' er tilbake og denne gangen har han venner!

programme.title: South Park: Døden
programme.desc: Stans bestefar prøver å lure guttene til å drepe ham. Foreldrene i South Park prøver å få stanset sendingene av 'Terrance and Phillip'.

programme.title: South Park: Den fattige ungen
programme.desc: Kennys foreldre blir arrestert og han plasseres i fosterhjem - så nå er Cartman det fattigste barnet på skolen! I mellomtiden kommer en mystisk figur fra fortiden tilbake.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion reiser seg
programme.desc: Ført an av 'Mysterion', jobber 'Coon' og vennene hans med å hjelpe folk i Gulfen. Og 'Coon' er ute etter hevn.

programme.title: South Park: Kassebilderby
programme.desc: Randy og Stan oppdager uforvarende warphastighet, så nå kan Jorden bli opptatt i Det galaktiske planetforbund, men en romgangster truer med å ødelegge alt.

programme.title: South Park: Rumpeburgere
programme.desc: Stans eksistensielle livskrise fortsetter, og Cartman går inn i burgerbransjen med en superspesiell hemmelig ingrediens.

programme.title: South Park: Informativ mordporno
programme.desc: Gutta bruker spillet Minecraft for å prøve å forhindre at foreldrene deres skader hverandre.

programme.title: South Park: Penger og gull
programme.desc: Stan bestefar kjøper et overpriset smykke til ham fra J & G handelsnettverk. Stan innser at han må redde sårbare seniorer fra handelsnettverk. Cartman starter sitt eget handelsnettverk når han ser hvor godt J & G handlenettverks taktikk fungerer.

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Når gutta reiser til Aspen for å stå på ski for første gang, legger Stan seg ut med lokalbefolkningen og blir utfordret til et løp.

programme.title: South Park: Freemium er ikke gratis
programme.desc: Stan blir avhengig av det nye mobilspillet med Terrance og Phillip.

programme.title: South Park: Skogsdyrenes jul
programme.desc: Julenissen må drepe alle onde dyr i South Park og redde verden etter at Stan narres til å hjelpe dem med fødselen til frelseren deres.

programme.title: South Park: South Parks fantastiske påskespesial
programme.desc: Stan vil finne opprinnelsen til malte påskeegg og oppdager en hemmelighet om den katolske kirken.

programme.title: South Park: Du har null venner
programme.desc: Mot bedre vitende, blir Stan med på Facebook og blir en sosialt nettworkende 'juggernaut', noe som forårsaker at han selv blir sugd inn i websiden.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O
programme.desc: Stan og Kyle står overfor sitt store gjennombrudd med Guitar Hero-ferdighetene sine. Manageren deres overbeviser Stan om at Kyle holder ham tilbake, og skaper spenninger mellom dem.

programme.title: South Park: City People
programme.desc: Da moren får en ny jobb blir Cartman misfornøyd.

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: Cartmans mor innser at hun ikke har kontroll på sønnen sin og søker eksperthjelp fra hundehviskeren Cesar Millan.

programme.title: South Park: Coon
programme.desc: Om dagen er han Eric Cartman, en feit gutt i 4. klasse. Om kvelden er han The Coon, en feit forbryterbekjemper og borgerverner som er utkledd som vaskebjørn og desperat etter oppmerksomhet.

programme.title: South Park: Kaptein Tjukkskjegg
programme.desc: Cartman har hørt om alle de rikdommene som blir plyndret av pirater i Somalia, så han setter en lapp over øyet og sleper gjengen med til Afrika for å få en bit av kaka.

programme.title: South Park: Medisinsk fritert kylling
programme.desc: Cartman blir rasende når han finner ut at hans yndlingsrestaurant er omgjort til en medisinsk marihuana-utlevering. Randy er ikke like skuffet.

programme.title: South Park: Slipp taket og styr
programme.desc: Cartman infiltrerer NSA for å avsløre dem og blir slett ikke glad for hva han finner i sin egen mappe.

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle trenger nyretransplantasjon og Cartman er den perfekte donor, men setter en høy pris for nyren: 10 millioner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Fettleir
programme.desc: Mrs. Cartman vil gjøre noe med sønnens spiseproblem og sender ham på slankeleir.

programme.title: South Park: Kravene heves
programme.desc: Cartman innrømmer endelig at han er feit og får umiddelbart en permobil.

programme.title: South Park: Pre-CIS
programme.desc: Ifølge Eric Cartman har Wendy Testaburger blitt lesbisk.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet III
programme.desc: Stan og Butters er fanget i Imaginationland og må kjempe for livet mot en hær av onde krefter. Kyle og Cartman er fortsatt i Pentagon.

programme.title: South Park: #Oppkok
programme.desc: Kyle vil bare spille tv-spill med lillebroren sin. Men da Ike vil ikke spille med ham mer, blir Kyle redd for at neste generasjon vil forbigå ham.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet I
programme.desc: Guttene kommer til et magisk land der hele verdens fantasi ligger foran dem, men terroristplaner truer med å ødelegge alt sammen.

programme.title: South Park: Vesenet
programme.desc: Kyles fetter Kyle Schwartz flytter til South Park på grunn av morens helseproblemer. Til å begynne med er Kyle glad for besøket, men det går ikke lang tid før 'Kyle 2' begynner å irritere ham.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Garrisons nye vakre vagina
programme.desc: Mr. Garrison skifter kjønn, og Kyle får en 'uvanlig' operasjon som gjør ham høy og sprek nok til å komme på basketballaget.

programme.title: South Park: Se opp for de selvgode!
programme.desc: South Parks innbyggere kjøper hybridbiler, men idet folk begynner å føle seg fornøyde fordi de redder verden, samler en mørk sky seg over byen.

programme.title: South Park: Det er en Jersey-greie
programme.desc: Byen South Park må forsvare seg mot å bli overkjørt av New Jersey og realitystjernene derfra.

programme.title: South Park: HumancentiPad
programme.desc: Kyle blir kidnappet av Apple etter å ha unngått å lese et kontraktstillegg. Apple har store planer med ham, og det må bli gutta som redder ham.

programme.title: South Park: Tiss
programme.desc: Høyt urininnhold i svømmebassenget fører til en katastrofe som ødelegger guttas dag, særlig Kyles. Og Cartmans xenofobi får fritt utløp igjen.

programme.title: South Park: Crackbabyforbundet
programme.desc: Da Kyle oppdager at Cartman deltar frivillig med 'crack babies' på lokalsykehuset blir han mistenksom. Og hvilken rolle spiller Slash (fra Guns 'n Roses) i alt dette?

programme.title: Fredag den 13.
programme.desc: Vi viser Fredagen den 13. del 2-8 filmene på denne kanalen i tillegg til nyinnspillingen fra 2009. Følg med for å se hva Jason Voorhees gjør best! Skrekken starter fra kl. 22.00 til tidlig morgen.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Drunk Like Me
programme.desc: Matt blows a gasket when his friend almost dies of alcohol poisoning in a fraternity initiation.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: Cutters
programme.desc: Lucy's new best friend is hiding something and Mary stumbles upon her secret.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: The Legacy
programme.desc: Matt's reading between the lines a little too much when he thinks his attractive English professor is coming on to him.

programme.title: 7th Heaven: ...And a Nice Chianti
programme.desc: Matt stops to help a pregnant girl having car trouble and she thanks him by hijacking his car!

programme.title: 7th Heaven: And The Home of the Brave
programme.desc: Grandpa and his fiance are getting married and Annie reluctantly prepares for the reception.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The historic home of JP Speed has morphed into an Arts College, carrying on the legacy of the local entrepreneur’s second wife, Harriet, who was passionate about sharing her love for music and the humanities and is said to still be haunting the home.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The DuPonts made their mark on America with a literal bang: Eleuthere DuPont built his family’s fortune with gunpowder. The sprawling family mansion in Old Louisville is the site of a scandalous murder that was covered up for decades.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Knutsford Crown Court. As they delve deeper into the building, will the ghosts and spirits make contact through Derek?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mill, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Weir Mill and the search for paranormal activity takes a darker turn. Will they finally uncover the truth behind the buildings dark hauntings?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Bulkeley Hotel
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Iron Chef Chen squares off against Munetaka Takahashi, a rising star from Kyoto, in an all-out battle of bamboo shoots.

programme.title: Iron Chef
programme.desc: Iron Chef Sakai's former apprentice, Mario Nakagawa, goes up against his master in the battle of lamb.

programme.title: Iron Chef

programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Blood
programme.desc: A army vet is found bleeding to death on the asphalt of a parking lot -- his chest littered with too many knife wounds to count. Kenda’s case is stuck in first gear until a gruesome clue appears.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The End
programme.desc: Kenda faces his most difficult case yet – the slaying of a young boy. The detective makes the most consequential decision of his career.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: When the Music Stops
programme.desc: Vietnam War veteran Charles Walker is found unconscious, after a stabbing attack so savage even 45 units of blood couldn’t save his life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Monster Awakes
programme.desc: When Julie Smith reports being sexually assaulted, Lt. Joe Kenda and his Sex Crimes Unit discover a terrifying similarity to other attacks on the east side of town.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Fare
programme.desc: A young man is found dead behind the wheel of his taxi. With robbery seeming unlikely, Kenda and Gaenzle wonder if this was personal.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: The Truth is in the Stars
programme.desc: Does our society have the capacity to live up to Star Trek's optimistic vision for humanity's future? William Shatner takes us on a journey to find out whether art has imitated life in the years since the world-renowned TV series premiered in 1966.

programme.title: Death By Gossip
programme.desc: When professional rodeo rider Randy Flynn is gunned down near his Kansas home, investigators hit a wall of whispers. Rumors fly of a philandering pastor and sex shop scandals.

programme.title: Death By Gossip
programme.desc: A Girl Scout Leader with a heart of gold, Lillian Jarvis is the last person to make enemies. When the young mother is killed by a mail bomb, secrets explode across the community.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Willy Pomonti Case
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris. It soon becomes clear that the man has been tortured prior to death.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Adeline Piet Case
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! What has happened to Adeline Piet?

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 102

programme.title: Henry Danger: Frittlestrøbbel

programme.title: Henry Danger: Munngodt
programme.desc: Jaspers entusiasme for skurkejakt får ham til å sende Captain Man og Kid Danger til hendelser som ikke er ulovlige. Så når han blir anklaget for innbrudd og sendt i fengsel må Henry og Ray finne en måte å få ham ut på.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Gasslekkasjen
programme.desc: Når Captain Man blir fanget under jorden, må Henry tenke ut en måte han kan snike seg ut av skolen på for å redde Ray.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kraften Kommer Del 1
programme.desc: Når Drex, en farlig forbryter som akkurat har rømt fra Solsyn fengsel, fornærmer Kid Danger og fanger Captain Man i en hjelm, må Kid Danger få hjelp av Schwoz for å få en superkraft som kan slå Drex.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kraften Kommer Del 2
programme.desc: Når Drex, en farlig forbryter som akkurat har rømt fra Solsyn fengsel, fornærmer Kid Danger og fanger Captain Man i en hjelm, må Kid Danger få hjelp av Schwoz for å få en superkraft som kan slå Drex.

programme.title: Henry Danger: SMS-Timer
programme.desc: Når Ray hører at Piper går på 'SinneMestring for Små' for å mestre sinne sitt, inngår Ray et veddemål med Henry på at han kan få henne til å bli sint før kvelden er over.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Grønne Fingre
programme.desc: Når Schwoz lager en sykdom som infiserer Charlotte, Henry og hans familie og Ray må ha sette dem i karantene i huset til Henry mens han finner en kur.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kanon-a-line Turneringen
programme.desc: Når Henry bruker sin nye superkraft for konkurrere i 'Kanon-a-line'-turneringen, må Ray, Schwoz og Charlotte ut på hemmelig oppdrag for å lære Henry en lekse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Invasjon fra Rommet del 1
programme.desc: Når Captain man og Kid Danger finner ut at en astronaut fra Solsyn er blitt fanget på romstasjonen, bruker de Kjærlighets-fergen til Schwoz ut i verdensrommet.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Invasjon fra Rommet Del 2
programme.desc: På romstasjonen oppdager Captain Man og Kid Danger at en liten jente har tatt astronautene til fange. Når de skjønner at astronautene gjør eksperimenter på kaniner, bestemmer de seg for å hjelpe henne.

programme.title: iCarly: iKamp mot Dingo
programme.desc: Dingo-kanalen har stjålet idéer fra iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer drar til Dingos Studio for å fortelle manusforfatterne hva de mener om det.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg tror de kysset
programme.desc: Da Sam kommer til å avsløre overfor Carly at hun og Freddie smugkysset, konfronterer Carly dem med hvorfor de ikke fortalte henne om det. Og Spencer underviser fanger i billedkunst i fengselet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokkekamp
programme.desc: Når Carl, Sam og Freddie vinner over en berømt tv-kokk i en matlagningskonkurranse, vil ikke kokken lage mat mer og nekter å komme ut av soverommet sitt. Spencer prøver å oppfylle en fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: Rektor kampen
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie får rektor Franklin sparket, overtar miss Briggs og mr. Howard ledelsen og innfører strenge regler. Og Spencer leier en gammel rodeostjerne til å lære ham å ri på en mekanisk okse.

programme.title: iCarly: iSpeed Date
programme.desc: Så mange gutter dukker opp til 'ta Carly med på fest'-konkurransen, at Carly, Sam og Freddie må benytte speed-dating for å møte dem alle sammen. Spencer følger et merkelig treningsprogram fra en ny app.

programme.title: iCarly: Stjernehjelp
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie skal lage en musikkvideo til en popstjernes comeback, oppdager de at popstjernen er ute av form og talentløs. Og Spencer oppdager at kvinnen han dater er Gibbys mor.

programme.title: iCarly: Livredderen
programme.desc: Når Freddie redder livet til Carly, forelsker Carly seg i ham. Sam og Spencer kjemper mot hverandre i et painball-spill som heter Assassin.

programme.title: iCarly: Lewberts tapte kjærlighet
programme.desc: Når gjengen oppdager at Lewbert engang var en lykkelig ung mann som var forlovet med en vakker kvinne, setter de seg fore å gjenforene det adskilte paret.

programme.title: iCarly: Missekonkurransen
programme.desc: Sam avslører overfor Carly og Freddie at hun deltok i skjønnhetskonkurranser som liten. Da hun finner ut at hennes rival skal konkurrere i Seattle, overbeviser hun Carly om å stille opp mot henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi avlyser ikke
programme.desc: Etter at Sam plutselig må i fengsel, lover Carly og Freddie dyrt og hellig å ikke avlyse nettshowet ettersom faren hennes skal se det. Carly ber Spencer om hjelp, men det blir vanskelig, for han skal på date.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna svever på toppen av verden da hun kommer hjem fra sitt første år på college, men hennes nye selvtillit rystes når hun oppdager at hun ikke er den eneste som har forandret seg.

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna avslører hva som hendte med henne og resten av gjengen i året som gikk - hva som var grunnen til isen som la seg mellom Matty og Jenna, hva som varmet forholdet mellom Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa gjenfant romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna unngår et nytt forhold for å få kontakt med dem hun jobber sammen med. I mens holder Tamara et chict bursdagsselskap for Sadie - som etterlater mer enn en festdeltager i slett festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å gjøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for henne selv, spleiser Jenna Tamara med en praktikant, men oppdager raskt at å jobbe med venner raskt kan bli en katastrofe.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake sikrer Jenna og Tamara skift på country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en etterfest på golfbanen resulterer i dramatiske fyrverkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Etter moroa på 4. juli, fortsetter Jenna og Matty å fyre opp under vennskapet ved å holde fest for Jake - i det minste inntil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med å avsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver å velge mellom suksess hos Idea Bin og sitt vennskap med Matty. Jake opplever et uventet intimt møte, og Sadie og Sergio driver plutselig og sparrer mer enn noen gang.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder seg som barnevakt og mottar uventet hjelp av Matty. I mens får Lissa vite hva som er hemmeligheten ved å være en Palos Hills-mamma, og Tamara og Sadie får mer en nok på en rik tenårings strandselskap.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tar forholdet med Luke ett nivå opp og Tamaras gjeld kommer tilbake og biter henne i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: En krangel med Luke presser Jenna til å bli med på leirgjenforeningen og dermed mot å gjenoppta kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjelper Jenna til å få et viktig møte på SCU, Tamara er ærlig mot Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjelp til å komme inn igjen i varmen hos Lacey.
